title: Fine Arts Performance Trip Travel Fee on an Ensemble Participation — Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
**Fine Arts travel fee schedule, Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees.** For a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, the travel fee posts under the Fine Arts travel fee schedule, on the date it is posted.

**When the travel fee may post.** The Fine Arts travel fee is not posted until the participation's records log carries the overnight travel permission form from the parent's signed packet. In the same terms: a participation whose records log carries no overnight travel permission form has no Fine Arts travel fee posted.

## Invocation: `post_arts_travel_fee_8b3017ab`

An agent-side tool, unlocked by the agent and then called: `post_arts_travel_fee_8b3017ab` books one new travel fee entry dated today on the participation's fee account; the household's amount due on the participation rises by that amount, and the entry appears in the fee history with its own reference number and amount.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `activity_participation_id` | reference number of the student's Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation, as returned by the activity participation lookup | identifier |
| `travel_fee_amount` | the travel fee to post, in US dollars | positive, 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent (half a cent rounds up); further digits are rounded half up to the cent |

**Receipt.** `activity_ledger_id` (the new entry's reference number), `activity_participation_id`, `fee_component` reading `travel_fee`, `amount` (US dollars, 2 decimals), `posted_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD) and `status` reading "posted".

**Error.** A malformed amount returns `status` "error" with a message and books nothing; an amount of 0.00 is not a positive amount.
